newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: IFC invests $37.5 mln in Philippine shipping firm.
newsitem.headline: IFC invests $37.5 mln in Philippine shipping firm.

text.p: The International Finance Corp, the World Bank's private sector investment arm, said on Tuesday it had approved a $37.5 million loan and equity financing to Philippines' A. Magsaysay Inc.

"We are entering the transportation sector and have now approved an investment of $37.5 million in A. Magsaysay Inc, a shipping company in the Philippines," IFC executive vice president Jannik Lindbaek told a Manila news conference.
The financing package will include an IFC covertible loan and a loan to be syndicated with international commercial banks.
He said the investment will help the company expand its regional and domestic fleet and reduce the age of its existing ships.
